subject: Hyperbolic Agent status: repro done, sweep half through, one trade-off
body:
Ulla, Bao,

Status. Repro is done: hyperbolic_rainbow from the shipped gin config (number_of_gammas=10, hyp_exponent=0.01, gamma_max=0.99, acting policy largest_gamma) matches the released numbers within noise on our 12-game subset, and we see the expected outsized gain on MontezumaRevenge - +14% average return over the Rainbow baseline at 50M frames.

Sweep is half through. Early read: dropping to 5 gammas keeps ~90% of the auxiliary-task benefit at ~1.15x baseline cost, which would be the sweet spot for the training stack.

Trade-off to flag: acting with largest_gamma is best on exploration games but slightly hurts on dense-reward ones (-3% median). If we want one default config for the stack we either accept that, or ship per-game acting policies, which complicates the story. Gustavo is quantifying both options for the memo.

On track for the June 15 recommendation.

Halima
